name: tuesday
description: Tuesday — a skincare brand gives its restock agent a $200/month budget. Three independent LLMs (Advocate, Auditor, Witness) adjudicate every purchase before any money moves: no PayPal order is created unless the gates pass, the vote including the disagreement is hashed into the order's custom_id, and each day's receipts are batched into a Merkle root anchored on a public chain.

scripts.test: node tests/moneyGate.test.js && node tests/disputeDesk.test.js && node tests/tribunal.fixture.mjs && node test_triad.mjs
